name: anhedral
description: Create and maintain Next.js web, native Expo, Hono, Drizzle/D1 and private R2 applications with optional Stripe and RevenueCat.

interface.longDescription: Six focused workflows for one stack: Next.js OpenNext web and native Expo frontends, Hono Worker, Drizzle/D1, private R2 and supporting Better Auth. Stripe and RevenueCat are the only optional additions. Generate editable source, keep provider credentials private, and verify product flows separately from deployment.
defaultPrompt: Create a new project using [@Anhedral](plugin://anhedral@anhedral). Start by explaining the stack and asking me what it should be about.
